{{Quote|On Naboo resides a slavemaster for the Blackscale clan, I will point you to his building. Be warned though, it's like a fortress and the slavers are not reasonable. It will probably be suicide to go there.|[[Wire]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:Gc" />}}
A '''house''' owned by a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]] led by slavemaster [[Trussk]] was located in the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Trussk and his slavers captured the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Arrworr]] and shipped him to the house where Trussk tortured him for weeks. Around the same time, the Blackscale Clan was tracking a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Cal Handro]]. Trussk wanted him dead for having smuggled slaves for a rival Trandoshan clan.<ref name="SWG:Gc" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of spacers assaulted the house. These adventurers were investigating the disappearance of Cal Handro and suspected the Blackscale Clan to have captured him. A violent fight erupted in the building and most slavers were killed, including slavemaster Trussk. Nevertheless, the rescued Wookiee Arrworr eventually revealed that the missing pilot had never been seen there.<ref name="SWG:Gc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trussk's house was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:Gc" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Trussk's house was added to the game with the third chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
